metaTitle: Santosh High School Bangarpet | SSLC School Kolar
metaDescription: Government-aided high school (SSLC) at Santosh High School, Bangarpet, Kolar District. Part of Santosh Group of Institutions founded 1977.
name: Santosh High School
tagline: Excellence in SSLC Board preparation and character formation
description: Santosh High School has an established record of high pass percentages and district distinctions in the Karnataka SSLC Board examinations. We balance rigorous test preparation with sports leadership and civic awareness.
highlights: Participation in taluk-level athletics and debates

features.title: Karnataka SSLC Board Mastery
features.detail: Experienced subject specialists guide students through the state syllabus with structured chapter revisions and preparatory test series.

features.title: Discipline & High Attendance Standards
features.detail: A compulsory 75% attendance policy and formal uniform code instill the personal decorum needed for higher academic life.

features.title: Taluk & District Athletic Representation
features.detail: Students compete regularly in taluk-level volleyball, athletics, and inter-school sports meets on our central grounds.

features.title: Pre-University Stream Orientation
features.detail: Individual counseling in Grade 10 helps students and parents choose the right combination between Science, Commerce, and Arts.
